$comment: ZIEE's declaration of its LIVE gallery-harness copies, consumed by
There is now ONE implementation. src-app/desktop/ui used to carry its own
forks of runtime-health.mjs and gate-ui.mjs; they were deleted and desktop
now runs these same sdk scripts with its own gallery.config.json, exactly as
src-app/ui already did. Parity is therefore true BY CONSTRUCTION rather than
checked by a guard - which is the point: the guard could only ever prove
wiring, never logic (a copy could keep the call and hardcode its result).
What remains worth checking is that a SECOND implementation has not
reappeared. That is the consumer test's discovery walk, not this list.
`role`: runtime-health PRODUCES the run manifest/verdict; gate-ui CONSUMES
them. Required cores are derived from the role by @ziee/gallery.
